PluginData.Author: yellow51
PluginData.Tooltip: Online multiplayer for Space Engineers 2: dedicated servers, hosting and joining over Steam or IP.
PluginData.Description:
Online multiplayer for Space Engineers 2: host your world, join friends over Steam or IP, or play on dedicated servers. Everyone in a session needs the same plugin version. Joining a server applies its custom rules to your game for that session.
Network use: checks se2-online.yellow51.dev for updates at start (optional). Listing a hosted session is opt-in and sends your SteamID64, session/world name and player counts to se2-online-sessions.yellow51.dev every 30 s. The server browser queries every listed address over Steam. Workshop mods a server needs are downloaded only after you agree (10 GiB cap by default); mods you have are updated to the server's version without asking.
On your PC: on Windows, a low-level keyboard hook runs while you are online or setting a key. A patch removes the crash handler SE2's AI library (VRage.KytheraV2.Native.dll) installs.
Server owners: without a streaming radius, every player receives the whole world state.
